title: Indiana man ordered to transfer ex-wife $35,000 from retirement fund and pay $2,500 in fees
summary_full: In a recent ruling, Indiana resident Russell Mangas faced contempt charges for not transferring $35,000 to his ex-wife, as originally agreed during their divorce settlement. He tried to argue that later agreements invalidated this obligation, but the court highlighted his original intentions and upheld the contempt ruling, including a $2,500 fee to cover his ex-wife's attorney costs, reinforcing the mandate for him to finalize the retirement fund transfer.
